name: hash_topk
description: Hash-routed MoE gate. Expert ids are looked up as tid2eid[input_ids], logits are gathered from router_logits, scored as sqrt(softplus(logit)), and normalized across routed slots. Shared slots get weight 1/routed_scaling_factor and ids num_routed+arange(num_fused_shared_experts). scoring_func must be 'sqrtsoftplus'. Returns weights float32 [T,topk_routed+shared] and ids int32 of the same shape. Current tests exercise bfloat16 router_logits, int32 ids/table, topk 4/8, shared 0/1 and scaling 2.5; inputs are read-only.
